mostWorthwhile.text: Clearing the bay was the most worthwhile passage: the marked route and accumulated rubble made the excavator's work tangible, while the lack of breathable air kept the outcome physically grounded.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the power cable was fairly predictable, though it gave the spoil hopper a practical role.

surprise.text: Inspecting the packed excavator automatically fitted steel as a spoil hopper; I expected only a compatibility report.

arbitrary.text: The steel fitting initially felt a little opaque because its purpose was not explained until the powered excavator caught spoil.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the sheltered but airless bay becomes a growing space, especially if the practical details remain as clear.
